analysis.summary_en: This prospective case-series at a quaternary care center characterized the otolaryngologic and audiometric phenotype in 44 WHIM syndrome patients followed for up to 17 years. Recurrent otitis media and sinusitis were common, with hearing loss in 43% and previously unreported maxillary sinus hypoplasia in 51% and olfactory dysfunction in 73%. Two cases of HPV-associated head and neck squamous cell carcinoma were identified. The authors propose a direct role for hyperfunctional CXCR4 in sinus development and olfaction and stress the importance of routine ENT and audiologic surveillance in WHIM patients. The single-center design and absence of controls limit causal conclusions and generalizability.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为表明功能亢进的 CXCR4 对鼻旁窦发育和气味感知可能具有非感染性直接影响,并且强调了 WHIM 综合征中听力损失的高风险。

papers.title: Dysregulation of the p16–CDK6 axis characterizes HPV-unrelated p16-positive oropharyngeal carcinoma
papers.abstract: Abstract Human papillomavirus (HPV)-related and HPV-unrelated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas (OPCs) are distinct entities with different clinical outcomes. While p16 immunohistochemistry (IHC) is widely used as a surrogate marker for HPV-driven OPC, a subset of HPV-unrelated OPCs also overexpress p16, and the biological basis of this discordance remains unclear. Here, we performed integrated clinicopathological, transcriptomic, genomic, and functional analyses of OPCs and demonstrated that dysregulation of the p16–CDK6 axis characterizes HPV-unrelated p16-positive OPCs. Although these tumors closely resembled HPV-unrelated p16-negative OPCs in their clinicopathological and transcriptomic characteristics, they exhibited a more favorable prognosis. CDK6 was recurrently upregulated in HPV-unrelated OPC regardless of p16 status and was already detectable in high-grade dysplastic leukoplakia, suggesting that CDK6 activation is an early event in HPV-unrelated tumorigenesis. In experimental models, CDK6 overexpression induced compensatory p16 upregulation, creating selective pressure for subsequent CDKN2A inactivation. Consistent with this model, homozygous CDKN2A loss predominated in p16-negative tumors. We further identified CDKN2A frameshift mutations generating p14ARF–p16 chimeric proteins that retain p16 immunoreactivity despite functional loss of wild-type p16, revealing a previously unrecognized diagnostic pitfall of p16 IHC. These findings provide a biological framework for p16 overexpression in HPV-unrelated OPC and suggest that assessment of the p16–CDK6 axis may refine molecular classification and risk stratification beyond p16 IHC alone.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 相关和 HPV 无关口咽鳞状细胞癌 (OPC) 是不同的实体,具有不同的临床结果。虽然 p16 免疫组织化学 (IHC) 被广泛用作 HPV 驱动的 OPC 的替代标记,但 HPV 无关的 OPC 子集也过度表达 p16,并且这种不一致的生物学基础仍不清楚。在这里,我们对 OPC 进行了综合的临床病理学、转录组学、基因组和功能分析,并证明 p16-CDK6 轴的失调是 HPV 无关的 p16 阳性 OPC 的特征。尽管这些肿瘤在临床病理学和转录组学特征上与 HPV 无关的 p16 阴性 OPC 非常相似,但它们表现出更良好的预后。无论 p16 状态如何,CDK6 在 HPV 无关的 OPC 中反复上调,并且在高度发育不良白斑中已可检测到,这表明 CDK6 激活是 HPV 无关肿瘤发生的早期事件。在实验模型中,CDK6 过表达诱导 p16 代偿性上调,为随后的 CDKN2A 失活产生选择性压力。与该模型一致,纯合 CDKN2A 缺失在 p16 阴性肿瘤中占主导地位。我们进一步鉴定了 CDKN2A 移码 突变 产生 p14ARF-p16 嵌合蛋白,尽管野生型 p16 功能丧失,但仍保留 p16 免疫反应性,揭示了 p16 IHC 先前未被识别的诊断缺陷。这些发现为 HPV 无关的 OPC 中 p16 过度表达提供了生物学框架,并表明对 p16-CDK6 轴的评估可能会完善 p16 IHC 之外的分子分类和风险分层。

papers.title: A pathogen-mimicking nanovaccine orchestrating danger recognition and immune activation for potent cellular immunity.
papers.abstract: Vaccines protect against infectious diseases by mimicking pathogens and delivering key signals required for immune activation. However, how to rationally emulate pathogen invasion processes to achieve potent cellular immunity remains a major challenge in vaccine design. Here, we propose a pathogen-mimicking delivery strategy based on the sequential processes of "danger recognition" and "immune activation". Mannatide derived from Streptococcus α-hemolyticus was incorporated into the formulation to mimic pathogen-associated carbohydrate structures, thereby promoting mannose receptor-mediated antigen-presenting cell (APC) targeting and immune recognition. Acting as a pathogen-associated "danger signal", mannatide facilitates APC recognition and provides the foundation for downstream immune activation. To further amplify immune responses, we identified escin sodium (Esc), screened from clinically used saponin molecules, as a novel immunostimulatory agent capable of activating APCs through interferon-associated signaling pathways. Using highly adsorptive aluminum hydroxide as the "pathogen structural scaffold", we developed a one-step microfluidic-assisted assembly strategy to construct aluminum hydroxide-mannatide nanovaccines (AlMN) co-loaded with antigen and Esc. AlMN markedly enhanced APC maturation, antigen-specific CD8+ T-cell activation, and durable immunological memory in vivo. In a TC-1 tumor model expressing human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated antigens, AlMN vaccination significantly delayed tumor progression, while combination with anti-PD-1 therapy further improved survival. Collectively, this pathogen-mimicking strategy integrating "danger recognition" and "immune activation" provides a conceptual framework for the rational design and optimization of next-generation vaccine delivery systems.

papers.abstract_zh: 疫苗 通过模仿病原体并传递免疫激活所需的关键信号来预防传染病。然而,如何合理模拟病原体入侵过程以实现有效的细胞免疫仍然是疫苗设计中的主要挑战。在这里,我们提出了一种基于“危险识别”和“免疫激活”连续过程的模仿病原体的递送策略。源自α-溶血链球菌的甘露聚糖肽被纳入制剂中,以模拟病原体相关的碳水化合物结构,从而促进甘露糖受体介导的抗原呈递细胞(APC)靶向和免疫识别。作为病原体相关的“危险信号”,甘露聚糖肽促进 APC 识别,并为下游免疫激活提供基础。为了进一步放大免疫应答,我们从临床使用的皂苷分子中筛选出七叶皂苷钠(Esc),作为一种新型免疫刺激剂,能够通过干扰素相关信号通路激活APC。使用高吸附性氢氧化铝作为“病原体结构支架”,我们开发了一种一步式微流体辅助组装策略来构建共负载抗原和Esc的氢氧化铝-甘露聚糖肽纳米疫苗(AlMN)。AlMN 显着增强了 APC 成熟、抗原特异性 CD8+ T 细胞激活和体内持久的免疫记忆。在表达 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 相关抗原的 TC-1 肿瘤模型中,AlMN 疫苗接种 显着延缓了肿瘤进展,而与抗 PD-1 疗法联合使用进一步提高了生存率。总的来说,这种整合“危险识别”和“免疫激活”的病原体模仿策略为下一代 疫苗 递送系统的合理设计和优化提供了概念框架。

papers.title: Acceptance of the nonavalent HPV vaccine among medical students: A knowledge, attitudes and practices study
papers.abstract: Objectives: Various strains of human papillomavirus (HPV) cause myriad cancers, and previous vaccines protected against the most common oncogenic ones. To increase the protective spectrum, the novel nonavalent vaccine has been introduced. Medical students are future physicians and potential key proponents of this vaccine; hence, awareness among them regarding this vaccine should boost its future adoption. Material and Methods: We assess the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) among medical students at a single college regarding the nonavalent HPV vaccine and specific reasons against its adoption. All willing medical students were administered a semi-objective questionnaire in English twice; once before a 20-minute visual training presentation on HPV vaccination and once after. The questionnaire contained 9 objective dichotomous questions and 5 questions pertaining to KAP. Training was imparted to batches of 15-20 students at a time. Results: There were 320 participants with a mean (SD) age of 20.39 (1.648) years, with 200 (62.5)% of them being females. Mean (SD) objective scores pre and post training were 4.47 (1.5) and 6.78 (1.308), respectively, showing significant improvement post training (p = 0.001). Second-year students improved significantly more compared to other years (p = 0.01). Knowledge regarding the vaccine significantly improved post-training according to the subjective dichotomous questions(p = 0.001); with 281 (87.8%) participants recommending the vaccine post-training compared to 215 (67.2%) pre-training (p = 0.001). Potential side effects of the nonavalent vaccine were the most common reason for not recommending the vaccine, which was almost completely addressed post-training, whereas the higher cost of the vaccine became the most prevalent reason. Conclusion: In conclusion, focused training improves the KAP of medical students and should enhance future widespread adoption of the nonavalent HPV vaccine.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 的各种毒株会导致多种癌症,而之前的 疫苗 可以预防最常见的致癌癌症。为了增加保护谱,引入了新型非价 疫苗。医学生是未来的医生,也是该 疫苗 的潜在关键支持者;因此,他们对 疫苗 的认识应该会促进其未来的采用。材料和方法:我们评估了一所大学的医学生关于非变异 HPV 疫苗 的知识、态度和实践 (KAP) 以及反对其采用的具体原因。所有愿意的医学生都接受了两次半客观英文问卷调查;在 HPV 疫苗接种 的 20 分钟视觉训练演示之前和之后各一次。问卷包含 9 个客观二分问题和 5 个与 KAP 相关的问题。培训一次对 15 至 20 名学生进行批次。结果:共有 320 名参与者,平均 (SD) 年龄为 20.39 (1.648) 岁,其中 200 (62.5)% 为女性。训练前后的平均 (SD) 客观分数分别为 4.47 (1.5) 和 6.78 (1.308),显示训练后显着改善 (p = 0.001)。与其他年级相比,二年级学生的进步显着更多(p = 0.01)。根据主观二分问题,有关 疫苗 的知识显着提高了培训后的效果(p = 0.001);培训后有 281 名 (87.8%) 参与者推荐 疫苗,而训练前有 215 名 (67.2%) 参与者推荐使用 疫苗 (p = 0.001)。非价 疫苗 的潜在副作用是不推荐 疫苗 的最常见原因,该问题在训练后几乎完全得到解决,而 疫苗 的较高成本成为最普遍的原因。结论:总而言之,集中培训可提高医学生的 KAP,并应促进非价 HPV 疫苗 未来的广泛采用。

papers.title: First-void urine and cervicovaginal brushes for vaginal microbiome profiling: a proof-of-concept study
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: The human vaginal microbiome is a cornerstone of female reproductive health, influencing susceptibility to vaginal conditions, pregnancy complications, and urogenital infections. Understanding this microbiome is critical for advancing preventive, diagnostic, and therapeutic interventions, yet its intimate and dynamic nature poses challenges for accurate, representative, and more inclusive sampling methods. This proof-of-concept study evaluated the performance of first-void urine (FVU) samples and cervicovaginal brushes for vaginal microbiome profiling relative to vaginal swabs. FVU refers to the initial stream of urine that flushes away cervicovaginal secretions that accumulate between the small labia and around the urethral opening, capturing immune, cancer, disease, pathogen, and microbiome biomarkers. Next to FVU, we evaluated cervicovaginal brushes, which are commonly used as self-sampling devices for human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA screening and thus present an interesting opportunity for evaluating the cervicovaginal microbiome while also collecting human vaginal cells. Here, we performed microbiome profiling in 10 women based on a total of 40 samples. In six out of nine participants, high-quality microbial profiles were obtained for both fresh FVU and cervicovaginal brush samples, comparable to those derived from vaginal swabs. Storage at room temperature for 7 days influenced the microbial composition of four out of seven FVU samples. Overall, our findings demonstrate the potential of FVU as a practical and accessible self-sampling method for advancing women's health research. IMPORTANCE: Current approaches for mapping and assessing the vaginal microbiome predominantly rely on sampling through vaginal swabs. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore alternative sampling methods for vaginal microbiome profiling, as current approaches using vaginal swabs are often perceived as uncomfortable and may be limited by cultural norms and privacy concerns, particularly in minors.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This proof-of-concept study evaluated the performance of first-void urine (FVU) samples and cervicovaginal brushes in 10 women, comparing them to vaginal swabs as the standard method.
analysis.methods: Microbiome profiling was conducted using 40 samples collected from 10 women, with FVU samples and cervicovaginal brushes assessed alongside vaginal swabs.
analysis.main_results: High-quality microbial profiles were obtained from both FVU and cervicovaginal brush samples in six out of nine participants, comparable to those from vaginal swabs. However, storage at room temperature for 7 days affected the microbial composition of four out of seven FVU samples.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that FVU and cervicovaginal brushes could serve as non-invasive, user-friendly alternatives to vaginal swabs for microbiome profiling, offering potential for more accessible and scalable research methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results could inform the development of more inclusive and practical sampling strategies for vaginal microbiome research, particularly in populations where traditional methods may be less acceptable or accessible.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited to a small sample size of 10 women, and the evidence is based on a proof-of-concept approach, which may not fully represent broader applicability or long-term stability of the sampling methods.

analysis.summary_en: This proof-of-concept study investigated the use of first-void urine (FVU) and cervicovaginal brushes as non-invasive alternatives to vaginal swabs for microbiome profiling. The research aimed to address the limitations of current sampling methods, which are often uncomfortable and culturally sensitive, especially in minors. The study evaluated these alternatives in 10 women, using a total of 40 samples. High-quality microbial profiles were obtained from both FVU and cervicovaginal brush samples in six out of nine participants, comparable to those from vaginal swabs. However, storage at room temperature for 7 days influenced the microbial composition of some FVU samples. The findings suggest that FVU and cervicovaginal brushes could offer practical and accessible methods for vaginal microbiome research, potentially enabling more inclusive studies. The study's small sample size and proof-of-concept nature limit the strength of the evidence, but the results highlight the potential for alternative sampling strategies in women's health research.

papers.abstract_zh: 未标记:人类阴道微生物组是女性生殖健康的基石,影响阴道疾病、妊娠并发症和泌尿生殖道感染的易感性。了解这种微生物组对于推进预防、诊断和治疗干预措施至关重要,但其密切和动态的性质对准确、有代表性和更具包容性的采样方法提出了挑战。这项概念验证研究评估了首次排尿 (FVU) 样本和宫颈阴道刷相对于阴道拭子进行阴道微生物组分析的性能。FVU 是指最初的尿液流,可冲走积聚在小阴唇之间和尿道开口周围的宫颈阴道分泌物,捕获免疫、癌症、疾病、病原体和微生物组生物标志物。除了 FVU 之外,我们还评估了宫颈阴道刷,这种刷通常用作 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) DNA 筛查的自采样装置,因此为评估宫颈阴道微生物群同时收集人类阴道细胞提供了一个有趣的机会。在这里,我们基于总共 40 个样本对 10 名女性进行了微生物组分析。九名参与者中有六名的新鲜 FVU 和宫颈阴道刷样本均获得了高质量的微生物特征,与阴道拭子样本相当。室温储存 7 天影响了七个 FVU 样品中四个的微生物组成。总体而言,我们的研究结果证明了 FVU 作为一种实用且易于使用的自我采样方法的潜力,可促进女性健康研究。重要性:目前绘制和评估阴道微生物组的方法主要依赖于通过阴道拭子采样。然而,它们的使用可能会被认为是不舒服的,某些社区的文化规范、耻辱和隐私问题也会限制它们的可接受性和可及性,尤其是对于未成年人。在这项概念验证研究中,我们表明,首次排尿(FVU)样本和宫颈阴道刷可以用作阴道微生物组研究中的非侵入性、用户友好的替代品,从而为微生物组成分分析提供更方便和可扩展的方法,为未来项目中的大规模应用铺平道路。这也将使我们能够对儿童阴道微生物组进行纵向研究,并探索其 进化 直至成年期,捕捉基本上尚未表征的微生物群落动态。这些改进可以加强我们对阴道微生物群及其在女性健康中的作用的了解。

papers.title: An Outer Membrane Vesicle-Based Vaccine Combined with alb-Flt3L Promotes Durable Antitumor Immunity in HPV-Associated Cancer
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated cancers remain a major global health burden, and no therapeutic cancer vaccine has yet been approved. Oncoprotein E7 plays a key role in tumor initiation and progression and has been identified as a potential target. Here, we aim to improve the efficacy and durability of an outer membrane vesicle (OMV)-based E7-targeted vaccine, SOMV-9RE7, through alb-Flt3L combination therapy. Methods: The antitumor efficacy and durability of the combination therapy were evaluated in low-burden and high-burden HPV-positive TC-1 tumor-bearing mouse models. Systemic and local immune responses were investigated by flow cytometry. Results: Combination with alb-Flt3L improved the tumor control and prolonged the therapeutic durability of SOMV-9RE7 compared with monotherapy groups, with more than half of the treated mice surviving beyond 60 days. This combination strategy enhanced E7-specific CD8+ T cell immunity in peripheral blood and the spleen, reduced myeloid-derived suppressor cell (MDSC)-mediated immunosuppression, promoted splenic T cell memory formation, and reshaped the tumor microenvironment. analysis.research_question_and_background: HPV-associated cancers remain a major global health burden, and no therapeutic cancer vaccine has yet been approved, creating a need for more effective and durable vaccine strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated the antitumor efficacy and durability of an outer membrane vesicle (OMV)-based E7-targeted vaccine, SOMV-9RE7, combined with alb-Flt3L in HPV-positive TC-1 tumor-bearing mouse models.
analysis.methods: Antitumor efficacy was assessed in low-burden and high-burden tumor models, and systemic and local immune responses were investigated using flow cytometry.
analysis.main_results: Combination therapy improved tumor control and prolonged therapeutic durability compared with monotherapy, with more than half of treated mice surviving beyond 60 days, and enhanced E7-specific CD8+ T cell immunity, reduced MDSC-mediated immunosuppression, promoted splenic T cell memory formation, and reshaped the tumor microenvironment.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the therapeutic benefit as being associated with both systemic and local immune remodeling, supporting the combination therapy as a promising strategy for therapeutic cancer vaccines.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that combining SOMV-9RE7 with alb-Flt3L could improve therapeutic cancer vaccine efficacy and durability, informing future vaccine development and clinical translation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to mouse models and lacks human clinical data, which constrains generalizability and necessitates cautious interpretation of the therapeutic potential.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the unmet need for effective therapeutic vaccines against HPV-associated cancers by evaluating an OMV-based E7-targeted vaccine (SOMV-9RE7) combined with alb-Flt3L in HPV-positive TC-1 tumor-bearing mouse models. The combination therapy improved tumor control and survival beyond 60 days in more than half of treated mice, enhanced E7-specific CD8+ T cell responses, reduced immunosuppression by myeloid-derived suppressor cells, promoted T cell memory, and reshaped the tumor microenvironment. The authors attribute these benefits to systemic and local immune remodeling, proposing the strategy as promising for therapeutic cancer vaccines. However, the evidence is confined to preclinical mouse models and lacks human validation, limiting generalizability and clinical applicability.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 相关癌症仍然是全球主要的健康负担,目前尚无治疗癌症的 疫苗 获得批准。癌蛋白E7在肿瘤的发生和进展中发挥着关键作用,并已被确定为潜在的靶点。在这里,我们的目标是通过 alb-Flt3L 联合疗法提高基于外膜囊泡 (OMV) 的 E7 靶向 疫苗、SOMV-9RE7 的功效和耐久性。方法:在低负荷和高负荷 HPV 阳性 TC-1 荷瘤小鼠模型中评估联合疗法的抗肿瘤疗效和持久性。通过流式细胞术研究全身和局部 免疫应答。结果:与单药治疗组相比,与 alb-Flt3L 组合改善了肿瘤控制并延长了 SOMV-9RE7 的治疗持久性,超过一半的治疗小鼠存活超过 60 天。这种组合策略增强了外周血和脾脏中E7特异性CD8+ T细胞免疫,减少了骨髓源性抑制细胞(MDSC)介导的免疫抑制,促进了脾T细胞记忆形成,并重塑了肿瘤微环境。结论:疫苗 SOMV-9RE7 与 alb-Flt3L 联合使用可提高抗肿瘤功效和持久性。这种治疗益处与全身和局部免疫重塑相关,支持联合疗法作为治疗癌症 疫苗 的有前途的策略。

news.content: 长者版 | 无障碍 | 邮箱 | EN 长者版 | 无障碍 | 邮箱 | EN 首页 机构概况 新闻资讯 政务公开 在线服务 互动交流 互动交流 留言选登 留言统计 征求意见 在线访谈 网上信访 在线服务 政务窗口 疾控科普 法定传染病目录 疾病预防控制标准 政务公开 政府信息公开 政策法规 政策解读 通知公告 党建工作 规划计划 疫情信息 财务信息 建议提案 人事信息 新闻资讯 时政要闻 国务院信息 疾控动态 新闻发布会 媒体聚焦 机构概况 机构职责 内设机构 登录|注册 |退出 语言版本 简体中文 当前位置: 首页 > 在线服务 > 疾控科普 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗系列科普问答 日期: 2026-08-18 来源:卫生与免疫规划司 字号:【 大 中 小】 分享到: 微信扫一扫:分享 扫一扫,分享给好友或朋友圈 一、我国宫颈癌的发病情况如何?与HPV感染有关系吗?HPV感染的高危因素有哪些? 宫颈癌是女性最常见的恶性肿瘤之一。国家癌症中心发布的数据显示,2022年我国宫颈癌新发病例为15.1万例,死亡病例是5.6万例,严重威胁女性身心健康。对宫颈癌分年龄段分析发现,发病率在20岁之前处于较低水平,20岁以后逐渐上升,至50—54岁年龄组达高峰,之后逐渐下降。近20年来,我国宫颈癌的发病率呈上升且年轻化的趋势。宫颈癌病因明确,主要是由高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)持续感染导致的。感染高危型HPV并不等于得宫颈癌,但如果持续感染,就有可能发生上皮内瘤样病变,或者进一步发展为宫颈癌。 发生HPV持续感染,还有一些高危因素,如吸烟、初次性行为年龄过早、多个性伴侣、感染其他疾病、免疫功能低下(如HIV感染者、器官/骨髓移植后患者、自身免疫性疾病患者、长期服用免疫抑制剂患者等)。具有这些因素的人群更容易发生HPV持续感染,进而患宫颈癌。 二、为适龄儿童免费提供国家免疫规划HPV疫苗接种服务,有哪些依据和意义? 《中华人民共和国疫苗管理法》规定,国家实行免疫规划制度,政府免费向居民提供免疫规划疫苗。2025年10月,国家疾控局、国家卫生健康委等七部门联合印发《关于将人乳头瘤病毒疫苗纳入国家免疫规划有关工作事宜的通知》,明确将HPV疫苗纳入国家免疫规划,各地为2011年11月10日以后出生的满13周岁女孩免费接种2剂次双价HPV疫苗。 研究表明,广泛接种疫苗,可以有效预防70%以上的宫颈癌发生,同时也可以降低因感染HPV导致的其他疾病的发生。其他国家和地区经验显示,将HPV疫苗纳入国家免疫规划,能够有效保障不同地区、不同收入水平的目标人群公平地获得预防接种服务,促进健康公平,提升疫苗接种率。我国将HPV疫苗纳入国家免疫规划,是坚持以人民为中心发展思想、贯彻落实健康优先发展战略的具体行动,是降低人群疾病负担、保障群众身体健康的惠民利民措施。 三、我国将HPV疫苗纳入国家免疫规划,确定13周岁女孩作为接种目标人群的考虑是什么? 自2025年11月起,我国将HPV疫苗纳入国家免疫规划,13周岁女孩作为目标人群,是综合考虑HPV感染风险、疫苗保护效果、成本效益以及实施可行性等因素作出的最优选择。 一是在HPV感染几率增大前,也就是发生初次性行为前,进行HPV疫苗接种,可以最大限度发挥疫苗预防HPV感染的作用,以获得更好的保护效果。二是国内外研究表明,9—14周岁女孩接种HPV疫苗产生的抗体水平,是15周岁以上人群的2倍以上,且保护效果可持续至少10年以上。在13周岁接种疫苗,可以获得更高的抗体水平和更持久的保护效果。三是全球为适龄女孩免费接种HPV疫苗的国家,目标人群多为11—13周岁女孩。我国将HPV疫苗纳入国家免疫规划之前,广东、江西、海南等省份通过民生项目等形式,为初中适龄女孩免费接种HPV疫苗,接种覆盖人群超千万,验证了将13周岁女孩作为接种目标人群的可行性。 四、为什么将双价HPV疫苗纳入国家免疫规划?如果已经接种四价、九价等其他价次的HPV疫苗,是否还需要接种免费的双价疫苗? 研究表明,至少70%的宫颈癌与HPV16型、18型持续感染有关,双价HPV疫苗可预防这两种型别的病毒感染,在预防由HPV感染引起的宫颈癌及癌前病变等方面具有较好的免疫效果。现阶段,我国将双价HPV疫苗纳入国家免疫规划,是综合考虑HPV感染及疾病负担、疫苗有效性和安全性、疫苗生产供应情况、财政可负担等多方面因素确定的。 如果适龄女孩已自费接种四价、九价HPV疫苗,也视同完成了免疫规划疫苗接种,不需要重复接种。四价、九价HPV疫苗除了预防宫颈癌外,还可以预防尖锐湿疣等疾病发生。适龄儿童家长可以综合考虑孩子的健康需求等实际情况,选择接种免费的国家免疫规划疫苗,或自费接种四价、九价疫苗。 五、纳入国家免疫规划的HPV疫苗接种程序如何?HPV疫苗可以和其他疫苗一起接种吗? 为2011年11月10日以后出生的、年龄满13周岁的女孩免费接种双价HPV疫苗,一共需要接种两剂次。完成首剂接种后,间隔半年接种第二剂次,间隔期最好不要超过一年。 临床研究证据证明,HPV疫苗和其他免疫规划疫苗(如甲肝疫苗、乙肝疫苗、百白破疫苗、脊髓灰质炎疫苗、流脑疫苗等)同时接种,没有发现有效性降低、安全性风险增加的情景。国际共识是:HPV疫苗可以与其他疫苗同时接种。如同时接种疫苗,要使用不同的注射器、选择不同的部位进行接种,如在左上臂接种HPV疫苗,可在右上臂接种其他疫苗。 六、HPV疫苗属于预防接种证查验的范围吗?未接种HPV疫苗是否影响入学? 《中华人民共和国疫苗管理法》规定,居住在中国境内的居民,依法享有接种免疫规划疫苗的权利,履行接种免疫规划疫苗的义务。HPV疫苗已纳入国家免疫规划,适龄女孩应当履行疫苗接种义务,监护人应当依法保证适龄女孩按时接种。 按照《儿童入托、入学预防接种证查验办法》规定,儿童入托、入学时,托幼机构、学校应当查验预防接种证。现阶段,全国所有托育机构、幼儿园和小学均应开展入托、入学预防接种证查验工作。其他类型学校是否纳入查验管理,由当地有关部门根据疾病防控需要确定。部分地区疾控、卫生健康、教育部门已将适龄女孩HPV疫苗接种情况纳入预防接种证查验内容,通过查验预防接种证,核实孩子疫苗接种情况,给家长和孩子提供健康提示,及时发现并补种漏种疫苗,保障儿童健康和校园公共卫生安全。适龄儿童家长应积极配合开展预防接种证查验工作,需要补种疫苗的及时补种。但是否完成HPV疫苗接种不是入学门槛,不会影响孩子入学。 七、感染了HPV后还需要接种疫苗吗?打完疫苗是否就一劳永逸了? HPV有200多种型别,如个体检测发现感染了HPV,可能感染了其中某一种或几种型别的病毒。对于个体来讲,即使已感染某一种或几种特定型别的HPV,接种疫苗仍然可以有效预防未感染的其他HPV亚型(疫苗包含型别)。 HPV疫苗属于预防性疫苗,对已经发生的病毒感染无清除作用,如已发生病变,也不能阻止病变的进展;即使接种疫苗,仍建议定期进行宫颈癌筛查,并保持健康的生活方式。部分人群因各种原因没有接种HPV疫苗,患病风险相对较高,需要定期进行宫颈癌筛查。 八、接种HPV疫苗有哪些注意事项? 国家免疫规划HPV疫苗的接种对象为未成年人,接种疫苗通常需要监护人(父亲、母亲或其他法定监护人)的陪同。接种前,建议孩子和家长提前了解HPV疫苗及其针对疾病的相关知识,以及接种的流程。接种时,监护人要携带本人及孩子身份证件(如身份证、户口本)、孩子的预防接种证,仔细阅读知情同意书,配合现场预防接种工作人员询问,详细提供孩子的健康状况以及既往的疾病史、过敏史、接种禁忌等情况,由接种医生来判断本次是否可以接种。如在学校设立的临时接种点接种疫苗,学生要提供监护人签署的知情同意书,再进行疫苗接种。 接种HPV疫苗后,可以用棉签轻轻按住接种部位,避免揉搓,并留观30分钟,以便及时发现和处理可能出现的不良反应。如果出现不适症状,需及时告知接种单位工作人员进行处理。回家后适当休息,保持接种部位清洁。如出现注射部位疼痛、红肿等局部反应,通常居家处理即可,如冷敷缓解疼痛等。如出现低热、乏力、食欲减退等情况,注意观察、多休息。如出现严重不适等情形,建议及时请医生诊治。 九、免费接种的双价HPV疫苗,在接种安全方面有哪些保障措施? 纳入国家免疫规划的国产双价HPV疫苗,已上市使用多年,已在十余个国家适龄儿童中接种,其安全性、有效性已得到充分验证。疫苗在研制、上市审批、生产和批签发、流通、预防接种全过程都有严格、规范的监管措施。在接种疫苗时,接种人员要严格按照《预防接种工作规范(2023年版)》实施操作,严格执行“三查七对一验证”、接种后30分钟留观等要求,保障接种工作的规范性和安全性。 十、错过了13岁免费接种时间,是否可以补种?已经自费打过一针,还能享受免费接种政策吗? 各地接种单位常态化开展免疫规划疫苗的查漏补种。符合出生日期要求的适龄女孩,如果因各种原因错过了HPV疫苗免费接种时间,可以到辖区接种点免费进行补种。建议家长及时带孩子到接种单位进行补种。已自费接种部分剂次的人群,可按原有程序完成全程接种。 扫一扫在手机打开当前页 手机版 微信公众号 国家疾病预防控制局 版权所有电脑端

《中华人民共和国疫苗管理法》规定,居住在中国境内的居民,依法享有接种免疫规划疫苗的权利,履行接种免疫规划疫苗的义务。HPV疫苗已纳入国家免疫规划,适龄女孩应当履行疫苗接种义务,监护人应当依法保证适龄女孩按时接种。 按照《儿童入托、入学预防接种证查验办法》规定,儿童入托、入学时,托幼机构、学校应当查验预防接种证。现阶段,全国所有托育机构、幼儿园和小学均应开展入托、入学预防接种证查验工作。其他类型学校是否纳入查验管理,由当地有关部门根据疾病防控需要确定。部分地区疾控、卫生健康、教育部门已将适龄女孩HPV疫苗接种情况纳入预防接种证查验内容,通过查验预防接种证,核实孩子疫苗接种情况,给家长和孩子提供健康提示,及时发现并补种漏种疫苗,保障儿童健康和校园公共卫生安全。适龄儿童家长应积极配合开展预防接种证查验工作,需要补种疫苗的及时补种。但是否完成HPV疫苗接种不是入学门槛,不会影响孩子入学。 七、感染了HPV后还需要接种疫苗吗?打完疫苗是否就一劳永逸了? HPV有200多种型别,如个体检测发现感染了HPV,可能感染了其中某一种或几种型别的病毒。对于个体来讲,即使已感染某一种或几种特定型别的HPV,接种疫苗仍然可以有效预防未感染的其他HPV亚型(疫苗包含型别)。 HPV疫苗属于预防性疫苗,对已经发生的病毒感染无清除作用,如已发生病变,也不能阻止病变的进展;即使接种疫苗,仍建议定期进行宫颈癌筛查,并保持健康的生活方式。部分人群因各种原因没有接种HPV疫苗,患病风险相对较高,需要定期进行宫颈癌筛查。 八、接种HPV疫苗有哪些注意事项? 国家免疫规划HPV疫苗的接种对象为未成年人,接种疫苗通常需要监护人(父亲、母亲或其他法定监护人)的陪同。接种前,建议孩子和家长提前了解HPV疫苗及其针对疾病的相关知识,以及接种的流程。接种时,监护人要携带本人及孩子身份证件(如身份证、户口本)、孩子的预防接种证,仔细阅读知情同意书,配合现场预防接种工作人员询问,详细提供孩子的健康状况以及既往的疾病史、过敏史、接种禁忌等情况,由接种医生来判断本次是否可以接种。如在学校设立的临时接种点接种疫苗,学生要提供监护人签署的知情同意书,再进行疫苗接种。 接种HPV疫苗后,可以用棉签轻轻按住接种部位,避免揉搓,并留观30分钟,以便及时发现和处理可能出现的不良反应。如果出现不适症状,需及时告知接种单位工作人员进行处理。回家后适当休息,保持接种部位清洁。如出现注射部位疼痛、红肿等局部反应,通常居家处理即可,如冷敷缓解疼痛等。如出现低热、乏力、食欲减退等情况,注意观察、多休息。如出现严重不适等情形,建议及时请医生诊治。 九、免费接种的双价HPV疫苗,在接种安全方面有哪些保障措施? 纳入国家免疫规划的国产双价HPV疫苗,已上市使用多年,已在十余个国家适龄儿童中接种,其安全性、有效性已得到充分验证。疫苗在研制、上市审批、生产和批签发、流通、预防接种全过程都有严格、规范的监管措施。在接种疫苗时,接种人员要严格按照《预防接种工作规范(2023年版)》实施操作,严格执行“三查七对一验证”、接种后30分钟留观等要求,保障接种工作的规范性和安全性。 十、错过了13岁免费接种时间,是否可以补种?已经自费打过一针,还能享受免费接种政策吗? 各地接种单位常态化开展免疫规划疫苗的查漏补种。符合出生日期要求的适龄女孩,如果因各种原因错过了HPV疫苗免费接种时间,可以到辖区接种点免费进行补种。建议家长及时带孩子到接种单位进行补种。已自费接种部分剂次的人群,可按原有程序完成全程接种。 扫一扫在手机打开当前页 手机版 微信公众号 国家疾病预防控制局 版权所有电脑端

analysis.brief_en: China’s National Immunization Program will provide free bivalent HPV vaccine to girls turning 13 years old from November 2025, following a seven-ministry policy issued in October 2025. The move aims to curb rising cervical cancer incidence—151,000 new cases and 56,000 deaths in 2022—driven largely by persistent infection with high-risk types HPV16 and HPV18. Vaccination is timed before sexual debut to maximize protection; clinical data show antibody levels in 9–14-year-olds are twice those in older cohorts and persist for at least a decade. The two-dose schedule can be administered alongside other childhood vaccines without loss of efficacy or safety. Catch-up vaccination is available for those who miss the window, and HPV vaccination is not required for school entry.

The two-dose schedule can be administered alongside other childhood vaccines without loss of efficacy or safety. news.content_title: Study finds link between antioxidant-rich diets and lower cervical cancer odds
news.content: Study finds link between antioxidant-rich diets and lower cervical cancer odds Written by Erika Watts on August 21, 2026 — Fact checked by Jill Seladi-Schulman, Ph.D. Could a diet high in antioxidants help prevent cervical cancer? istetiana/Getty Images Researchers examined whether higher dietary antioxidant intake, including vitamins A and C and zinc, was associated with the prevalence of cervical cancer. They analyzed data from more than 1,000 women who participated in a large U.S. health and nutrition survey. Women with the highest antioxidant intake had about 56% lower odds of having a history of cervical cancer compared with those with the lowest intake. Researchers say more studies are needed to better understand the relationship between antioxidant intake and cervical cancer risk. Cervical cancer, which is primarily caused by persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV), is a significant global health concern. Cervical cancer is less common in the U.S., but is one of the most common cancers that affects women worldwide, especially in lower-income countries. A new study examined the relationship between dietary antioxidant intake and cervical cancer and found that higher antioxidant intake was associated with a lower prevalence of the disease. The study was published in the International Journal of Gynecology & Obstetrics. How researchers measured dietary antioxidant intake There were more than 600,000 cases of cervical cancer and about 342,000 deaths from the disease worldwide in 2020. Although HPV vaccination and cervical cancer screening can help prevent the disease, access to these preventive measures is uneven, particularly in lower-income countries. Researchers are also interested in identifying additional modifiable factors that may contribute to the development of cervical cancer, including nutrition. For the new study, scientists analyzed data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), a program that assesses the health and nutritional status of people in the U.S. The researchers included 1,044 participants in their analysis. Of these, 174 had a self-reported history of cervical cancer, and 870 participants without cervical cancer served as matched controls. The team analyzed the participants’ diets using two nonconsecutive 24-hour dietary recall interviews. They then calculated each participant’s Composite Dietary Antioxidant Index (CDAI). The CDAI provides an overall measure of dietary antioxidant intake based on six components: vitamins A, C, E zinc selenium carotenoids Higher CDAI scores indicate higher overall dietary antioxidant intake. Antioxidants may help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation, which the researchers thought may contribute to HPV infection and cervical cancer development. The researchers used CDAI scores to examine whether overall antioxidant intake was associated with the prevalence of cervical cancer. They also accounted for factors such as age, race and ethnicity, income, smoking and alcohol use, and BMI. Higher antioxidant intake linked to lower cervical cancer prevalence After accounting for these factors, the researchers found that each 1-unit increase in CDAI score was associated with 11.4% lower odds of having a history of cervical cancer. Participants with the highest dietary antioxidant intake had about 56% lower odds of having a history of cervical cancer than those with the lowest intake. The study authors said that antioxidants may affect oxidative stress, inflammation, and immune responses, which could help explain the association. However, the findings do not show that a higher antioxidant intake prevents cervical cancer. The study had several limitations, including its cross-sectional design. Since the researchers assessed participants’ diets and cervical cancer history at a single point in time, they could not determine whether diet influenced cancer development or whether participants changed their diets after diagnosis. Participants also self-reported their cervical cancer diagnoses, and researchers did not have information about cervical cancer stage at diagnosis. The authors say that future studies should follow participants’ diets over time to better understand whether antioxidant intake affects cervical cancer development. Can antioxidants help with cervical cancer prevention? Jagdish Khubchandani, PhD, MPH, a public health professor at New Mexico State University, shared his thoughts on the study with Medical News Today. Khubchandani noted that while studies using NHANES data can provide valuable insights, dietary research has limitations, including relying on participants accurately recalling what they eat. However, he said there are several biological mechanisms that could help explain the findings. “Antioxidants in many dietary items (e.g., fruits and veggies) neutralize these toxins that can damage DNA in cells,” Khubchandani explained. “Furthermore, antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals in healthy diets also protect our tumor-suppressing proteins.” “The science is well established that healthy diets reduce the risk of cancers,” he said, adding that greater attention should be paid to improving “access, cost, and lifestyles.” 5 servings of fruit and veg a day as a starting point Khubchandani recommends aiming for five servings of fruits and vegetables daily when possible, while emphasizing that diet cannot prevent HPV infection when other risk factors are present. “Good diets can ensure a strong immune response to any infection,” Khubchandani emphasized. Laurie Brunette-Masi, MD, a board certified gynecologic oncologist at City of Hope Orange County in Irvine, California, told MNT that the findings should be interpreted cautiously. “It is important, however, not to interpret this as proof that antioxidants prevent cervical cancer,” said Brunette-Masi. “This was an observational study that shows an association, not cause and effect.” Brunette-Masi noted that antioxidants are part of a healthy lifestyle and may help support immune function, but emphasized that HPV vaccination and recommended cervical cancer screening are “the foundation” of cervical cancer prevention. “A healthy diet may be another piece of the prevention picture, but it should complement, not replace, these proven measures,” said Brunette-Masi. news.content: Medscape AI News & Perspective Tools & Reference CME/CE More EN RegisterLog In AI Mode Medscape Medical NewsMedBrief Medbrief HPV Vaccination Underutilized in Solid Organ Transplant Recipients Edited by Deepa Varma August 20, 2026 Add to Email Alerts TOPLINE Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination rates remain low in solid organ transplant recipients (SOTRs), despite their elevated risk for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC), and the association of HPV with post-transplant cSCC, a review shows. METHODOLOGY Researchers conducted a systematic review of 16 studies involving pediatric and adult SOTRs published from January 2006 through August 2025. Two reviewers independently screened articles, extracted data, and assessed quality using Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluations and Joanna Briggs Institute tools, with discrepancies adjudicated by a third reviewer. Studies were categorized according to vaccination uptake, immunogenicity, or HPV-associated lesion outcomes. TAKEAWAY HPV vaccination rates were consistently low in SOTR cohorts (six studies), particularly among adults; pharmacist-led counseling and structured infectious disease consultations increased uptake. Seroconversion rates for HPV 6, 11, 16, and 18 ranged from 52% to 90% (six studies), compared with more than 99% observed in immunocompetent individuals; HPV16 seroconversion was among the highest across cohorts. Greater immunosuppression, including higher tacrolimus levels, mycophenolate use, lung transplant status, and earlier post-transplant vaccination, predicted lower immune response to HPV vaccination. Efficacy data from four studies suggested reductions in HPV-associated lesion burden with vaccination, including fewer cervical complications, reduction in keratinocyte carcinoma incidence, resolution of squamous cell carcinoma in situ, and decreased wart recurrence. IN PRACTICE "HPV vaccination is underutilized in SOTRs, though targeted interventions may improve uptake," the authors wrote. "Post-transplant vaccination elicits attenuated but measurable immune responses, influenced by immunosuppression intensity and timing," they added. SOURCE The study was led by Elizabeth Fan, BA, Duke University School of Medicine, Durham, North Carolina, and was published online on August 7 in JAAD Reviews. LIMITATIONS The efficacy evidence was limited by small, heterogeneous studies that could not establish causality. DISCLOSURES The study received no funding. The authors disclosed having no relevant conflicts of interest. SUGGESTED FOR YOU This article was created using several editorial tools, including AI, as part of the process. Human editors reviewed this content before publication. Topics & Projects Antimicrobial Stewardship Chronic Wasting Disease Osterholm Update Podcasts Newsletters About CIDRAP CIDRAP in the News Our Staff Our Director Osterholm in the Press Shop Merchandise Contact Us About Search CLOSE Search Support Menu People vaccinated against HPV have lower risk of head and neck cancer, study suggests Liz Szabo, MA Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Heather Hazzan / Self magazine Share Copied to clipboard People vaccinated against the human papillomavirus (HPV) were much less likely to develop cancers of the head and neck, according to a study published this week in the International Journal of Infectious Diseases. The study confirms earlier research finding a vaccine-related decrease in head and neck cancers. The new study analyzed 1.4 million medical records from 66 US healthcare organizations. Half of the research subjects were vaccinated against HPV from ages 9 to 45. The other half were vaccinated against other diseases but not HPV. Study participants were vaccinated from January 2011 to June 2024. People vaccinated from age 9 to 26 years—the age range recommended by the American Academy of Pediatrics—were 68% less likely to be diagnosed as having head or neck cancer, according to the study. There was no statistically significant reduction in head and neck cancers in people vaccinated from age 27 to 45, most likely because these people had been exposed to HPV before being immunized, said Ching-Nung Wu, MD, PhD, first author of the paper and an otolaryngologist at Kaohsiung Chang Gung Memorial Hospital in Taiwan. A common cause of cancer HPV causes nearly all cases of cervical cancer, along with more than 90% of anal cancers, 75% of vaginal cancers, 70% of vulvar and head and neck cancers, and 63% of penile cancers. A study published in December 2025 found the vaccine reduces the risk of tumors of the vagina and vulva. A study published in April found that men and boys who received the HPV vaccine from ages nine to 26 were nearly 50% less likely to develop cancers of the head and neck, esophagus, anus, or penis. Although head and neck cancers were once caused mostly by tobacco and alcohol use, most of these tumors are now caused by HPV. Cancers related to HPV tend to develop in an area called the oropharynx, which includes the tonsils, base of the tongue, back part of the roof of the mouth, and the side and back walls of the throat. In the new study, people vaccinated against HPV were 91% less likely to be diagnosed as having oropharyngeal cancers. Statistical uncertainty Independent scientists note that the total number of head and neck cancers diagnosed among study participants was very small, with 40 among people vaccinated against HPV and 130 in the comparison group. Oropharyngeal cancers made up a fraction of these tumors. That makes it tricky to estimate the exact reduction in risk, said Taito Kitano, DrPH, a researcher at Nara Prefecture General Medical Center in Nara, Japan, who was not involved in the new study. Although Wu and his colleagues followed up with study participants for 13 years after the patients were vaccinated, that may not have been a long enough time to judge their cancer risk. Head and neck cancers are typically diagnosed in older men, at an average age of 64, according to the American Cancer Society. “These figures should be read as an observational association, not a precise causal estimate of vaccine effectiveness,” Wu told CIDRAP News. These figures should be read as an observational association, not a precise causal estimate of vaccine effectiveness. “What gives us confidence in the overall direction, rather than the exact magnitude, is the consistency of the findings: The protective association held across cancer subsites, across subgroups, and persisted five to 13 years after vaccination, and it is biologically plausible given HPV's established causal role in oropharyngeal cancer.” Larger study needed To truly understand how many oropharyngeal cancers are prevented with HPV vaccines, Kitano said scientists would have to perform a larger study and follow participants for a longer time. In spite of the study’s limitations, “it is a good trend and something we should continue to follow over time,” said Mark Einstein, MD, chair of obstetrics and gynecology and women’s health at Montefiore Medical Center in New York. analysis.summary_en: A study published in the International Journal of Infectious Diseases on August 21, 2026, suggests that people vaccinated against human papillomavirus (HPV) have a lower risk of developing head and neck cancer. The research analyzed 1.4 million medical records from 66 US healthcare organizations, with participants vaccinated from ages 9 to 45. Those vaccinated between ages 9 and 26 were 68% less likely to be diagnosed with head or neck cancer, while no significant reduction was observed in those vaccinated between 27 and 45, likely due to prior HPV exposure. The study also found that HPV vaccination was associated with a 91% lower likelihood of oropharyngeal cancer, which includes the tonsils, base of the tongue, and throat. However, the small number of cases (40 among vaccinated individuals and 130 in the comparison group) and the 13-year follow-up period raise statistical uncertainty. Researchers emphasized that the findings should be viewed as an observational association rather than a definitive causal link. They called for larger studies and longer follow-up to better understand the vaccine's impact on cancer prevention. The study highlights HPV's established role in causing oropharyngeal cancer and supports ongoing efforts to monitor its effects over time.

elements_en.time: The study was published on 2026-08-21. The research analyzed medical records from January 2011 to June 2024, with follow-up for 13 years after vaccination.
elements_en.location_and_population: The study involved 1.4 million medical records from 66 US healthcare organizations. Participants included individuals vaccinated against HPV from ages 9 to 45, and those vaccinated against other diseases but not HPV.
elements_en.event: A study published in the International Journal of Infectious Diseases suggests that people vaccinated against HPV have a lower risk of head and neck cancer. The findings confirm earlier research on this association and indicate a 68% reduced likelihood of head or neck cancer among those vaccinated from ages 9 to 26, with no significant reduction in those vaccinated from 27 to 45.
elements_en.scale_impact_and_risk: The study found that HPV vaccination was associated with a 91% lower likelihood of oropharyngeal cancer. However, the total number of head and neck cancers diagnosed was small (40 among vaccinated individuals and 130 in the comparison group), making it difficult to estimate the exact risk reduction. The study also noted that most head and neck cancers are now caused by HPV, and the protective association persisted across cancer subsites and subgroups.
elements_en.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study's findings are described as an observational association rather than a precise causal estimate of vaccine effectiveness. Independent scientists highlighted statistical uncertainty due to the small number of cases. The researchers acknowledged that the 13-year follow-up may not have been long enough to fully assess cancer risk. The study's limitations include the need for larger research and longer follow-up periods to confirm the exact impact of HPV vaccination on cancer prevention.

女子感染的是哪种HPV类型,会致癌吗? 2026年08月21日 00:10 看点资讯 语音播报 缩小字体 放大字体 微博 微信 分享 0 腾讯QQ QQ空间 武汉一名28岁女子因长期使用公用瑜伽垫,后背冒出成片褐色小疙瘩,就医后确诊为皮肤型HPV(人乳头瘤病毒)感染引发的扁平疣——这是与宫颈癌无关的低危型HPV,不会致癌,无需过度恐慌。 一、感染的是哪类HPV:低危型皮肤HPV,非宫颈癌相关型别 病毒亚型:该女子感染的是引起扁平疣的低危型皮肤HPV,主要通过皮肤直接接触传播,并非通过性接触传播。 关键区别:HPV家族有200多种亚型,高危型(如HPV16、18等)持续感染才与宫颈癌相关,而本次案例属于皮肤低危型,与宫颈癌完全是两回事。 临床表现:感染后后背出现褐色或淡肤色扁平丘疹,呈片状分布,可伴瘙痒,抓挠后沿抓痕呈线性排列。 二、感染途径与致病条件:公用瑜伽垫是感染源头 病毒存活环境:公用瑜伽垫缝隙易残留汗液、皮屑,夏季湿热环境下HPV病毒可在垫面存活数小时。 入侵机制:运动时皮肤与垫面摩擦产生肉眼难见的微小破损,后背、手臂直接接触垫面,病毒"乘虚而入";出汗后皮肤角质层软化、屏障减弱,感染风险更高。 诊断依据:武汉市第三医院皮肤科主治医师刘睿检查后确诊为典型扁平疣,追问发现该女子练习瑜伽3个月一直使用公用垫、从未自备。 三、风险评估与科学应对:可治愈、可预防,不必恐慌 良性病变:低危型HPV引起的扁平疣属于良性皮肤增生,不具有癌变潜能,通过规范治疗(如冷冻、激光)可去除。 防护建议:运动时尽量自备瑜伽垫或铺隔脏毛巾;必须使用公用垫时,先用消毒湿巾擦拭并等垫面干透;皮肤有擦伤、裂口时避免直接接触公共垫子。 就医提示:身上出现不明原因、持续增多的小疙瘩,应及时到正规医院皮肤科就诊,切勿自行用药或抠抓,以免病毒扩散。 注:以上内容仅为医学科普,不构成诊疗建议,如有皮肤异常请及时线下就医。 0条评论|0人参与网友评论 表情 登录|注册 |退出 分享到微博 发布 最热评论 刷新 最新评论 刷新 更多精彩评论>> 相关新闻 加载中 点击加载更多 头条号入驻 财经自媒体联盟更多自媒体作者 今日推荐 优秀作者 看点月榜 盘点全球具身智能30强:谁能让机器人真正工作? 女子感染的是哪种HPV类型,会致癌吗? 2026年08月21日 00:10 看点资讯 语音播报 缩小字体 放大字体 微博 微信 分享 0 腾讯QQ QQ空间 武汉一名28岁女子因长期使用公用瑜伽垫,后背冒出成片褐色小疙瘩,就医后确诊为皮肤型HPV(人乳头瘤病毒)感染引发的扁平疣——这是与宫颈癌无关的低危型HPV,不会致癌,无需过度恐慌。 一、感染的是哪类HPV:低危型皮肤HPV,非宫颈癌相关型别 病毒亚型:该女子感染的是引起扁平疣的低危型皮肤HPV,主要通过皮肤直接接触传播,并非通过性接触传播。 关键区别:HPV家族有200多种亚型,高危型(如HPV16、18等)持续感染才与宫颈癌相关,而本次案例属于皮肤低危型,与宫颈癌完全是两回事。 临床表现:感染后后背出现褐色或淡肤色扁平丘疹,呈片状分布,可伴瘙痒,抓挠后沿抓痕呈线性排列。 二、感染途径与致病条件:公用瑜伽垫是感染源头 病毒存活环境:公用瑜伽垫缝隙易残留汗液、皮屑,夏季湿热环境下HPV病毒可在垫面存活数小时。 入侵机制:运动时皮肤与垫面摩擦产生肉眼难见的微小破损,后背、手臂直接接触垫面,病毒"乘虚而入";出汗后皮肤角质层软化、屏障减弱,感染风险更高。 诊断依据:武汉市第三医院皮肤科主治医师刘睿检查后确诊为典型扁平疣,追问发现该女子练习瑜伽3个月一直使用公用垫、从未自备。 三、风险评估与科学应对:可治愈、可预防,不必恐慌 良性病变:低危型HPV引起的扁平疣属于良性皮肤增生,不具有癌变潜能,通过规范治疗(如冷冻、激光)可去除。 防护建议:运动时尽量自备瑜伽垫或铺隔脏毛巾;必须使用公用垫时,先用消毒湿巾擦拭并等垫面干透;皮肤有擦伤、裂口时避免直接接触公共垫子。 就医提示:身上出现不明原因、持续增多的小疙瘩,应及时到正规医院皮肤科就诊,切勿自行用药或抠抓,以免病毒扩散。 注:以上内容仅为医学科普,不构成诊疗建议,如有皮肤异常请及时线下就医。 0条评论|0人参与网友评论 表情 登录|注册 |退出 分享到微博 发布 最热评论 刷新 最新评论 刷新 更多精彩评论>> 相关新闻 加载中 点击加载更多 头条号入驻 财经自媒体联盟更多自媒体作者 今日推荐 优秀作者 看点月榜 盘点全球具身智能30强:谁能让机器人真正工作? analysis.brief_en: A 28-year-old woman in Wuhan, China, was diagnosed with flat warts caused by a low-risk cutaneous HPV infection after repeatedly using a shared yoga mat. Health authorities clarified that the strain involved is not linked to high-risk HPV types associated with cervical cancer and poses no oncogenic risk. The infection is benign and treatable with standard dermatological procedures such as cryotherapy or laser therapy. Public health advice includes avoiding shared mats, disinfecting surfaces before use, and seeking medical evaluation for unexplained skin lesions. The case is isolated, with no evidence of broader transmission or systemic impact.

news.content: 21.08.2026LV Facebook Twitter Baltics Social Politics Money Interviews Opinions In Focus World Leisure Advertising Search BNN NewsBNN - Baltic News Network BNN NewsBNN - Baltic News Network Baltics Social Politics Money Interviews Opinions In Focus World Leisure Advertising Search Discover more Biological Sciences Family Law infection HomeBalticsLatvia LatviaSocial SPKC urges parents not to delay: this vaccine can significantly reduce the risk of several types of cancer LETA August 18, 2026 Facebook Twitter Photo; Magnific The Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC) is urging parents to use the final weeks of the summer holidays to vaccinate their children against human papillomavirus (HPV), thereby protecting them against several types of HPV-related cancer. HPV is an infection transmitted primarily through sexual contact that infects the deeper layers of the skin and mucous membranes. Almost all sexually active people become infected with HPV at some point in their lives, usually without experiencing any symptoms. More than 200 types of HPV have been identified. SPKC notes that once the school year begins, daily routines become busier for children and families, making vaccination appointments more difficult to schedule. Parents are therefore encouraged not to postpone vaccination. As of the 12th of August this year, 54.7% of children born in 2012 and 2013 had received the first dose of the vaccine, while 42.8% had received the second dose, according to SPKC data. A total of 37,243 vaccine doses have been administered to children born in these years, while the target group consists of 38,297 children. Discover more Vaccines & Immunizations Public Health Medical Facilities & Services SPKC points out that more than 15 years of experience in Europe has produced compelling scientific evidence demonstrating the effectiveness of vaccination in protecting against cervical cancer. Large-scale studies conducted in Sweden, Denmark and the Netherlands have found significant reductions in HPV infections and precancerous lesions, as well as a lower incidence of cervical cancer among vaccinated women. Results from a long-term study conducted in Sweden show that girls vaccinated before the age of 17 had an 88% lower incidence of cervical cancer compared with unvaccinated girls. Long-term follow-up data also confirm that the vaccine’s protective effect persists for many years after vaccination. Most sexually active people become infected with HPV at some point during their lifetime. In many cases, the infection clears on its own. However, certain high-risk HPV types can cause cervical cancer as well as cancers of the anus, vagina, vulva, penis, mouth and throat. Certain types of the virus can also cause genital warts, SPKC explains. Vaccination is most effective when administered before exposure to the virus, meaning before a person becomes sexually active. Vaccination is therefore recommended during adolescence in accordance with the national vaccination schedule. Discover more vaccines infections vaccine SPKC reminds women that even those who have been vaccinated should regularly participate in cervical cancer screening, as HPV vaccines do not protect against all of the less common HPV types. This year marks 20 years since the first HPV vaccine was approved in the European Union in 2006. In Latvia, state-funded HPV vaccination for girls was introduced in 2010, while vaccination for boys was introduced in 2022. Currently, vaccination is recommended for both girls and boys in all European Union and European Economic Area countries. Latvia’s national vaccination schedule provides for HPV vaccination at the age of 12. If vaccination is not carried out at the recommended age or has been delayed, it is funded by the state up to and including the age of 25. Vaccination can be scheduled alongside a preventive health check with a family doctor before the start of the new school year. SPKC notes that once school begins, daily routines become busier for children and families, making it more difficult to arrange a vaccination appointment. The World Health Organization has set a target of achieving 90% HPV vaccination coverage among girls by the age of 15. Iceland, Portugal and Norway have already reached this target. Large-scale studies conducted in Sweden, Denmark and the Netherlands have found significant reductions in HPV infections and precancerous lesions, as well as a lower incidence of cervical cancer among vaccinated women. news.content: EPAPER LIVE TV DAWNNEWS URDU Images Herald Aurora CityFM89 Advertise Events Supplements Careers Obituaries Dawn E-Paper | August 22, 2026 Home Latest Violations Tracker Pakistan Opinion Business ACT Images Prism World Sport Breathe Magazines Tech Videos Popular Archive Flood Donations Home Latest Violations Tracker Pakistan Opinion Business ACT Images Prism World Sport Breathe Magazines Tech Videos Popular Archive Flood Donations Search Search Subscribe to notifications Get the latest news and updates from Dawn Not Now Allow Notifications HPV vaccination Muslima Ejaz Ahmed Published August 18, 2026 Email Your Name* Recipient Email* Cancel 1 The writer is an epidemiologist and public health researcher at Aga Khan University. Her research focuses on HPV, implementation science, vaccine confidence and health equity in Pakistan. Listen to article 1x 1.2x 1.5x comments Join our Whatsapp Channel Add Dawn as a trusted source EVERY public health breakthrough carries two promises: that science can prevent disease and that people will trust it enough to embrace it. Scientific progress alone cannot fulfil the second promise. Pakistan’s introduction of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine into its national immunisation programme is a historic milestone in the fight against cervical cancer. The vaccine offers girls protection from a largely preventable disease. But introduction is only the beginning. Long-term success will depend not only on vaccine delivery but on whether families have confidence in it. Cervical cancer is one of the few cancers that can largely be prevented. Persistent infection with high-risk HPV causes almost all cases, and decades of evidence show that vaccination substantially reduces HPV infection and precancerous lesions and can prevent cervical cancer. Pakistan now has the opportunity to achieve these gains. Science answers one question: does the vaccine work? Communities ask another: can I trust it? Pakistan has the vaccine. Now it must build trust. Our GLOBE-HPV research among women in urban informal settlements and rural communities across Pakistan offers an important insight. Awareness of HPV and cervical cancer was remarkably limited; many women had never heard of HPV and cervical cancer screening was virtually nonexistent. Yet when information was shared clearly and respectfully, many expressed willingness to embrace preventive measures. This should encourage us. Communities are not rejecting science. They are asking for information they can understand and sources they can trust. Public health has often assumed that facts alone change behaviour. Experience tells us otherwise. People make health decisions through relationships of trust with healthcare professionals, teachers, family members, neighbours and, for many Pakistani families, religious scholars. Recognising this does not weaken science; it strengthens public health. Trust is built through dialogue, not instruction. Community engagement should therefore be a core part of vaccine implementation from the beginning, not an afterthought. Healthcare workers need confidence to answer questions about vaccine safety, effectiveness and fertility with empathy and clarity. Teachers, schools and community organisations also need accurate information so that reliable information reaches families before misinformation does. Religious engagement deserves similar attention. For many Pakistani families, faith and healthcare are complementary sources of guidance. Several Muslim-majority countries have incorporated HPV vaccination into national programmes, and Pakistan’s health authorities have affirmed that leading Islamic scholars support HPV vaccination and consider it consistent with Islamic values. The lesson is not that religion validates science but that science and faith can work together to protect future generations. Implementation science offers another lesson: successful vaccination programmes rely not only on evidence but also on transparent communication, political commitment, strong primary healthcare, community partnerships and public trust. Trust cannot be built during a crisis. It must be cultivated early by listening to concerns, answering difficult questions honestly and ensuring that families feel their voices matter. Pakistan has taken the historic first step. The next challenge is to make HPV vaccination a lasting public health success rather than simply another campaign. This means moving beyond counting doses towards building confidence, listening to concerns and ensuring that every family has access to trusted, understandable information. Trust cannot be built after misinformation has taken hold. It must be cultivated early through honest conversations, respon-sive healthcare providers, informed teachers and meaningful engagement with communities. If we get this right, Pakistan’s HPV programme can become more than a vaccination campaign; it can become a model for how science, communities and public health systems can work together. Years from now, the success of Pakistan’s HPV vaccination programme should not be measured only by the number of girls who received the vaccine. It should be measured by the women who never develop cervical cancer, the families spared preventable loss and the generations protected because trust allowed science to reach those who needed it most. Pakistan has the vaccine. Now it must build the trust that allows the vaccine to fulfil its promise. Vaccines prevent cervical cancer. Trust ensures that they can fulfil that promise. 熊艳)“这是我送给儿子18岁的成人礼。”近日,即将步入大学的小赵在湖南省妇幼保健院完成了HPV疫苗第二剂次接种,他的母亲笑着对医生说道。这份专属青春的健康礼物,让这个暑期的成长仪式格外有意义。随着暑期疫苗接种高峰来临,不少家长主动带青春期男孩预约接种HPV疫苗,大众对于HPV防护的健康观念正在逐步更新。 湖南省妇幼保健院宫颈疾病诊治中心(肿瘤妇科与宫颈疾病专科)负责人、主任医师赵璟介绍,长期以来,社会普遍存在“HPV疫苗只为女性接种”的固有认知,很多市民并不了解男性同样存在HPV感染风险,也不清楚男孩接种疫苗的重要价值。针对这一普遍认知误区,赵璟主任结合临床经验,全方位科普男性HPV感染与疫苗接种相关知识,引导青少年做好科学健康防护。什么是HPV?一种“很会藏”的病毒HPV的中文名是人乳头瘤病毒,专门感染人体皮肤和黏膜的上皮细胞,口腔、咽喉、阴茎、外阴、肛门、阴道、宫颈、直肠都是它的“目标地”。目前已发现的病毒型别有200多种,按致癌风险可分为高危型和低危型。其中,高危型HPV的长期持续感染,是诱发宫颈癌、肛门癌等多种癌症的明确诱因。很多人误以为HPV是“女性病毒”,实际上,HPV传播途径以性接触为主,也可通过共用毛巾、浴具等皮肤直接接触方式间接传播。全球范围内,九成男性在一生中至少会感染一次HPV,男性青少年的感染率长期处于较高水平。一项系统回顾和荟萃分析显示,15至19岁男孩生殖器HPV感染率达到28%,HPV感染防护不分性别,无论男女均不能掉以轻心。男性感染HPV有哪些症状与危害?多数HPV感染为一过性,可通过人体免疫系统自行清除,但男性清除病毒的能力普遍低于女性,且更容易发生重复感染,潜藏诸多健康隐患。一旦高危型HPV持续感染,可能诱发肛门癌、阴茎癌、口咽癌、喉癌等疾病,近年来国内此类癌症的发病率持续上升;低危型HPV感染则会引发尖锐湿疣,该病复发率高、治疗过程繁琐,会严重影响患者的日常生活质量。有相关心理研究显示,HPV检测阳性的男性,更容易出现沮丧、负罪感、担忧、抑郁等负面情绪。男性感染HPV不仅会带来躯体疾病风险,还会造成沉重的心理负担,形成身心健康双重受损的局面。疫苗不是“女生专属”,男女均可接种长期以来,HPV疫苗常被贴上“女性专用”的标签,但在全球公共卫生领域,HPV疫苗早已是男女通用的健康防护防线。目前,九价HPV疫苗可有效预防HPV16、18型引发的肛门癌,HPV6、11型引发的生殖器疣,以及HPV6、11、16、18型相关的各类癌前病变。男性接种HPV疫苗,不仅能够守护自身健康,有效预防生殖器疣、病毒持续感染及相关癌变,还能降低将病毒传播给伴侣的风险,对女性宫颈癌等疾病可起到间接预防作用,实现双向健康防护。现有临床数据显示,九价HPV疫苗在男性群体中安全性良好。常见不良反应多为轻微、一过性症状,局部反应包括注射部位疼痛、肿胀,全身反应包括发热、头痛、恶心,无需过度担忧。在防护效力方面,该疫苗对男性一般人群相关生殖器病变的保护效力达90.4%,对HPV持续感染的保护效力为85.9%,防护数据扎实、效果明确可靠。接种流程、免疫程序及注意事项有哪些?接种HPV疫苗是预防HPV感染最关键的主动防护手段,但无法实现百分之百防护。男性需将疫苗接种与日常健康管理相结合,全方位抵御病毒侵袭。日常生活中,需保持健康的性行为习惯,固定性伴侣,规避高危感染风险;存在高危行为的男性,需定期开展HPV专项检测,做到早筛查、早发现、早干预;同时坚持规律作息、均衡膳食、适度运动,提升自身免疫力,依靠人体免疫系统抵御、清除病毒。接种流程:采取上臂三角肌肌肉注射方式,接种后需在门诊留观30分钟,无异常后方可离开。免疫程序:严格按照0、2、6月周期完成三针全程接种,第三针需在第一针接种后的12个月内完成,保障完整免疫效果。注意事项:适龄健康男生接种前无需提前做HPV检测,可直接预约接种;体温≥37.5°C或处于急性疾病发作期,需暂缓接种;对酵母及疫苗相关成分过敏者禁止接种;接种当日无需空腹,正常饮食即可;接种后24小时内避免剧烈运动,保持接种部位清洁干燥。赵璟表示,长久以来的性别偏见,让很多男性忽视了HPV防护的重要性。HPV防护从来不是单一的女性健康课题,而是全民必须重视的健康必修课。正值暑期升学季,广大即将步入校园的青少年男性,应打破固有健康认知误区,正视自身健康防护。在开启人生新征程的同时,主动接种HPV疫苗,既学会尊重、守护他人,也用心守护自己,为青春筑牢坚实的健康壁垒。 湖南省妇幼保健院宫颈疾病诊治中心(肿瘤妇科与宫颈疾病专科)负责人、主任医师赵璟介绍,长期以来,社会普遍存在“HPV疫苗只为女性接种”的固有认知,很多市民并不了解男性同样存在HPV感染风险,也不清楚男孩接种疫苗的重要价值。针对这一普遍认知误区,赵璟主任结合临床经验,全方位科普男性HPV感染与疫苗接种相关知识,引导青少年做好科学健康防护。什么是HPV?一种“很会藏”的病毒HPV的中文名是人乳头瘤病毒,专门感染人体皮肤和黏膜的上皮细胞,口腔、咽喉、阴茎、外阴、肛门、阴道、宫颈、直肠都是它的“目标地”。目前已发现的病毒型别有200多种,按致癌风险可分为高危型和低危型。其中,高危型HPV的长期持续感染,是诱发宫颈癌、肛门癌等多种癌症的明确诱因。很多人误以为HPV是“女性病毒”,实际上,HPV传播途径以性接触为主,也可通过共用毛巾、浴具等皮肤直接接触方式间接传播。全球范围内,九成男性在一生中至少会感染一次HPV,男性青少年的感染率长期处于较高水平。一项系统回顾和荟萃分析显示,15至19岁男孩生殖器HPV感染率达到28%,HPV感染防护不分性别,无论男女均不能掉以轻心。男性感染HPV有哪些症状与危害?多数HPV感染为一过性,可通过人体免疫系统自行清除,但男性清除病毒的能力普遍低于女性,且更容易发生重复感染,潜藏诸多健康隐患。一旦高危型HPV持续感染,可能诱发肛门癌、阴茎癌、口咽癌、喉癌等疾病,近年来国内此类癌症的发病率持续上升;低危型HPV感染则会引发尖锐湿疣,该病复发率高、治疗过程繁琐,会严重影响患者的日常生活质量。有相关心理研究显示,HPV检测阳性的男性,更容易出现沮丧、负罪感、担忧、抑郁等负面情绪。男性感染HPV不仅会带来躯体疾病风险,还会造成沉重的心理负担,形成身心健康双重受损的局面。疫苗不是“女生专属”,男女均可接种长期以来,HPV疫苗常被贴上“女性专用”的标签,但在全球公共卫生领域,HPV疫苗早已是男女通用的健康防护防线。目前,九价HPV疫苗可有效预防HPV16、18型引发的肛门癌,HPV6、11型引发的生殖器疣,以及HPV6、11、16、18型相关的各类癌前病变。男性接种HPV疫苗,不仅能够守护自身健康,有效预防生殖器疣、病毒持续感染及相关癌变,还能降低将病毒传播给伴侣的风险,对女性宫颈癌等疾病可起到间接预防作用,实现双向健康防护。现有临床数据显示,九价HPV疫苗在男性群体中安全性良好。常见不良反应多为轻微、一过性症状,局部反应包括注射部位疼痛、肿胀,全身反应包括发热、头痛、恶心,无需过度担忧。在防护效力方面,该疫苗对男性一般人群相关生殖器病变的保护效力达90.4%,对HPV持续感染的保护效力为85.9%,防护数据扎实、效果明确可靠。接种流程、免疫程序及注意事项有哪些?接种HPV疫苗是预防HPV感染最关键的主动防护手段,但无法实现百分之百防护。男性需将疫苗接种与日常健康管理相结合,全方位抵御病毒侵袭。日常生活中,需保持健康的性行为习惯,固定性伴侣,规避高危感染风险;存在高危行为的男性,需定期开展HPV专项检测,做到早筛查、早发现、早干预;同时坚持规律作息、均衡膳食、适度运动,提升自身免疫力,依靠人体免疫系统抵御、清除病毒。接种流程:采取上臂三角肌肌肉注射方式,接种后需在门诊留观30分钟,无异常后方可离开。免疫程序:严格按照0、2、6月周期完成三针全程接种,第三针需在第一针接种后的12个月内完成,保障完整免疫效果。注意事项:适龄健康男生接种前无需提前做HPV检测,可直接预约接种;体温≥37.5°C或处于急性疾病发作期,需暂缓接种;对酵母及疫苗相关成分过敏者禁止接种;接种当日无需空腹,正常饮食即可;接种后24小时内避免剧烈运动,保持接种部位清洁干燥。赵璟表示,长久以来的性别偏见,让很多男性忽视了HPV防护的重要性。HPV防护从来不是单一的女性健康课题,而是全民必须重视的健康必修课。正值暑期升学季,广大即将步入校园的青少年男性,应打破固有健康认知误区,正视自身健康防护。在开启人生新征程的同时,主动接种HPV疫苗,既学会尊重、守护他人,也用心守护自己,为青春筑牢坚实的健康壁垒。 analysis.event: A male teenager received his second dose of the HPV vaccine at the Hunan Provincial Maternal and Child Health Hospital. The risk of HPV infection in males is presented as high, but the vaccine reduces personal and transmission risk.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The hospital is actively offering HPV vaccination to eligible boys and encourages uptake. Zhao highlighted the safety profile and recommended the standard three‐dose schedule (0, 2, 6 months). No unresolved questions are noted beyond the usual vaccine side‐effects, and the article serves as public‐health guidance.

analysis.brief_en: Sina Finance reported on 18 August 2026 that a teenage boy in Hunan Province’s Maternal and Child Health Hospital completed his second dose of the nine‐valent HPV vaccine. Hospital director Dr. Zhao Jing used the case to correct the misconception that HPV vaccination is only for women, explaining that males also face a high infection risk—about 28% among 15‐19‐year‐olds—and can suffer cancers and genital warts. The vaccine is described as safe, with mild side effects, and offers roughly 90% protection against genital lesions and 86% against persistent infection in men. The hospital is promoting routine vaccination for eligible boys, following a three‐dose schedule, and urges families to view HPV prevention as a shared health responsibility.

The hospital is promoting routine vaccination for eligible boys, following a three‐dose schedule, and urges families to view HPV prevention as a shared health responsibility.

news.content: 澎湃号·湃客 > 预防宫颈癌,可不只是打HPV疫苗这么简单 人卫健康 人卫健康官方澎湃号 2026-08-17 08:01 北京 宫颈癌,被称为“红颜杀手”,尤其“偏爱”妙龄女子。 除了“红颜杀手”外,宫颈癌还有“冷血杀手”的称号,因为它的传播途径与艾滋病相似,也是性行为。 而且宫颈癌在早期多半没有症状,它悄无声息,或者即使有症状也容易被忽视。它不像感冒、肠炎、肺炎等疾病那样,会让你咳嗽、流涕、腹泻、喘不过气,就像一个训练有素的“杀手”,在黑暗处等待着给你致命一击。 图库版权图片,转载使用可能引发版权纠纷 宫颈癌真有这么可怕吗? 2021年世界卫生组织统计,宫颈癌全球每年有52.5万新发病例和27.5万死亡病例,而中国的新发病例和死亡病例约占全球的1/5。 具体来说,每30~35个女性中,就有一个女性在一生中某个时期不幸发生宫颈癌。全球每2分钟,就会有一名女性因宫颈癌去世。 宫颈癌又不是传染病,为何要打疫苗? 因为宫颈癌是由人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)持续感染引起的疾病。HPV家族很大,有些危险性很低;有些则危险性很高,高危型HPV有14种(HPV16、18、31、33、35、39、45、51、52、56、58、59、66、68)。所以,打疫苗防宫颈癌,实际上是用疫苗防HPV感染。 图库版权图片,转载使用可能引发版权纠纷 打了疫苗,就可以彻底防住宫颈癌吗? 这是一个错误想法。 古人说:“上医治未病,中医治欲病,下医治已病。”宫颈癌的防控体系,主要分为三级。就相当于足球中所说的后腰、后卫和守门员。 宫颈癌的第一道防线,就是病因学预防,也就是打HPV疫苗。世界卫生组织认为,除了调整生活行为方式外,HPV疫苗接种是宫颈癌最有效的一级预防措施。 世界卫生组织提出,9~45岁的女性,如果有条件,都推荐接种HPV疫苗。目前,HPV疫苗有二价、四价和九价疫苗。 二价疫苗 可以预防HPV16、18感染,超过70%的宫颈癌都是由这两种病毒引起的。 四价疫苗 能预防HPV6、11、16、18感染,其中HPV6、11不属于高危型病毒,但会引起尖锐湿疣。 九价疫苗 能预防HPV6、11、16、18、31、33、45、52、58感染。 图库版权图片,转载使用可能引发版权纠纷 第二道防线是什么?第二道防线是做好疾病的二级防控,这属于发病学预防,即对高风险人群进行检查,检出癌前病变和早癌,以早期治疗。其主要筛查方法包括薄层液基细胞学检查(TCT)和HPV检测。 不同人群的具体筛查办法见下表: 人群 推荐的 筛查方法 建议 <21岁 不筛查 _ 21~29岁 每3年单独行TCT _ 30~65岁 每5年行联合筛查 不推荐单独行HPV筛查 >65岁 既往筛查有足够的阴性结果,可终止筛查 既往有高度病变史,治疗后继续筛查不少于20年 子宫切除后 无须筛查 既往有高度病变史,继续行单独TCT不少于20年 接种HPV疫苗后 同未接种人群 _ 第三道防线又是什么呢?第三道防线,就是对确诊的、各个期别的宫颈癌患者给予手术切除、放疗加化疗等治疗。目前早期宫颈癌治疗效果很好,晚期的仍不理想。 这里有个概念,即治疗效果。癌症的治疗效果常用5年生存率来衡量。1期宫颈癌,5年生存率能达到80%,但4期宫颈癌只有20%。所以说等得病了再治疗,早就晚三秋了。 做好一、二级预防,才能真正预防宫颈癌! 内容来源: 人民卫生出版社出版《协和医生说2:坚持做好这些事健康生活一辈子》 本文作者: 国家健康科普专家库专家 北京协和医院主任医师 谭先杰 文章声明 本材料仅供疾病认知教育使用,无意提供任何医疗建议或推荐具体治疗方案,与您个体疾病状况有关的任何治疗方案或其他医疗相关问题,请咨询您的主治医生。 图片版权问题 本文封面图片和文内图片均来自版权图库,转载时请注意,避免侵权。 END 原标题:《预防宫颈癌,可不只是打HPV疫苗这么简单!》 阅读原文 特别声明 本文为澎湃号作者或机构在澎湃新闻上传并发布,仅代表该作者或机构观点,不代表澎湃新闻的观点或立场,澎湃新闻仅提供信息发布平台。申请澎湃号请用电脑访问https://renzheng.thepaper.cn。 相关推荐 国家疾控局发布HPV疫苗科普十问十答 绿政公署 3天前 HPV疫苗 更多内容 医者说|共用瑜伽垫也会感染HPV?谈谈被忽视的扁平疣 直击现场 13小时前 01:03 怎样改善提高胃脾胃功能?医生分享简单小方法 中医洪惠玲大夫 4天前 mRNA癌症疫苗引爆医药板块:治疗癌症新曙光?国内哪些药企有布局? 这是一个错误想法。 古人说:“上医治未病,中医治欲病,下医治已病。”宫颈癌的防控体系,主要分为三级。就相当于足球中所说的后腰、后卫和守门员。 宫颈癌的第一道防线,就是病因学预防,也就是打HPV疫苗。世界卫生组织认为,除了调整生活行为方式外,HPV疫苗接种是宫颈癌最有效的一级预防措施。 世界卫生组织提出,9~45岁的女性,如果有条件,都推荐接种HPV疫苗。目前,HPV疫苗有二价、四价和九价疫苗。 二价疫苗 可以预防HPV16、18感染,超过70%的宫颈癌都是由这两种病毒引起的。 四价疫苗 能预防HPV6、11、16、18感染,其中HPV6、11不属于高危型病毒,但会引起尖锐湿疣。 九价疫苗 能预防HPV6、11、16、18、31、33、45、52、58感染。 图库版权图片,转载使用可能引发版权纠纷 第二道防线是什么?第二道防线是做好疾病的二级防控,这属于发病学预防,即对高风险人群进行检查,检出癌前病变和早癌,以早期治疗。其主要筛查方法包括薄层液基细胞学检查(TCT)和HPV检测。 不同人群的具体筛查办法见下表: 人群 推荐的 筛查方法 建议 <21岁 不筛查 _ 21~29岁 每3年单独行TCT _ 30~65岁 每5年行联合筛查 不推荐单独行HPV筛查 >65岁 既往筛查有足够的阴性结果,可终止筛查 既往有高度病变史,治疗后继续筛查不少于20年 子宫切除后 无须筛查 既往有高度病变史,继续行单独TCT不少于20年 接种HPV疫苗后 同未接种人群 _ 第三道防线又是什么呢?第三道防线,就是对确诊的、各个期别的宫颈癌患者给予手术切除、放疗加化疗等治疗。目前早期宫颈癌治疗效果很好,晚期的仍不理想。 这里有个概念,即治疗效果。癌症的治疗效果常用5年生存率来衡量。1期宫颈癌,5年生存率能达到80%,但4期宫颈癌只有20%。所以说等得病了再治疗,早就晚三秋了。 做好一、二级预防,才能真正预防宫颈癌! 内容来源: 人民卫生出版社出版《协和医生说2:坚持做好这些事健康生活一辈子》 本文作者: 国家健康科普专家库专家 北京协和医院主任医师 谭先杰 文章声明 本材料仅供疾病认知教育使用,无意提供任何医疗建议或推荐具体治疗方案,与您个体疾病状况有关的任何治疗方案或其他医疗相关问题,请咨询您的主治医生。 图片版权问题 本文封面图片和文内图片均来自版权图库,转载时请注意,避免侵权。 END 原标题:《预防宫颈癌,可不只是打HPV疫苗这么简单!》 阅读原文 特别声明 本文为澎湃号作者或机构在澎湃新闻上传并发布,仅代表该作者或机构观点,不代表澎湃新闻的观点或立场,澎湃新闻仅提供信息发布平台。申请澎湃号请用电脑访问https://renzheng.thepaper.cn。 相关推荐 国家疾控局发布HPV疫苗科普十问十答 绿政公署 3天前 HPV疫苗 更多内容 医者说|共用瑜伽垫也会感染HPV?谈谈被忽视的扁平疣 直击现场 13小时前 01:03 怎样改善提高胃脾胃功能?医生分享简单小方法 中医洪惠玲大夫 4天前 mRNA癌症疫苗引爆医药板块:治疗癌症新曙光?国内哪些药企有布局? analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Global: 525,000 new cases and 275,000 deaths annually; China accounts for ~20% of global cases and deaths. Lifetime risk: 1 in 30–35 women. Every 2 minutes, one woman dies globally from cervical cancer. High-risk HPV types include 14 types (e.g., HPV16, 18, 31, 33, 45, 52, 58). Early-stage 5-year survival: 80%; late-stage: 20%.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: WHO recommends HPV vaccination for women aged 9–45 years (bivalent, quadrivalent, or nonavalent vaccines). Screening recommendations: <21 years: no screening; 21–29 years: TCT every 3 years; 30–65 years: co-testing every 5 years; >65 years: stop if prior negative results; post-hysterectomy: no screening unless prior high-grade lesion. Vaccination does not guarantee complete protection; screening remains essential. Source limitation: guidance article, not an outbreak report.

analysis.brief_en: A guidance article published by thepaper.cn on 17 August 2026 highlights that cervical cancer prevention extends beyond HPV vaccination alone. Authored by a national health expert and based on WHO data, the piece underscores the global burden—525,000 new cases and 275,000 deaths annually, with China accounting for one-fifth of cases. It explains that 14 high-risk HPV types drive most disease, and vaccination (available as bivalent, quadrivalent, or nonavalent) is most effective when combined with regular screening. Screening schedules vary by age and risk, with early-stage 5-year survival at 80% versus 20% for late-stage disease. The article stresses that vaccination does not eliminate risk and that screening remains critical for early detection.

news.content_zh: 澎湃新闻于2026年8月17日发表的一篇指导文章强调,宫颈癌的预防不仅仅限于HPV 疫苗接种。这篇文章由一位国家卫生专家根据世界卫生组织的数据撰写,强调了全球负担——每年新增 525,000 例新病例和 275,000 例死亡,其中中国占病例的五分之一。它解释了 14 种 高危型HPV 类型会导致大多数疾病,而 疫苗接种(二价、四价或九价)与定期筛查相结合时最有效。筛查时间表因年龄和风险而异,早期疾病的 5 年生存率为 80%,而晚期疾病的 5 年生存率为 20%。文章强调,疫苗接种 并不能消除风险,筛查对于早期发现仍然至关重要。

analysis.time: Published 2026-08-21 18:40:30; event occurred over 3 months prior to publication, with onset of symptoms approximately 2 weeks before medical consultation.
analysis.location_and_population: Wuhan City, Hubei Province, China; affected individual is a 28-year-old woman (identified as Ms. Li) practicing yoga in public facilities.
analysis.event: A confirmed case of skin-type HPV infection (flat warts) reported by a dermatologist at Wuhan Third Hospital, attributed to repeated use of shared yoga mats without personal hygiene measures.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Single confirmed case; no deaths or exposures reported beyond the index patient. Risk emphasized as elevated during summer due to viral survival on moist surfaces and microtrauma from friction during exercise.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: Medical investigation confirmed HPV subtype via clinical diagnosis; public health guidance emphasized avoiding shared mats and maintaining skin integrity. No formal outbreak response or contact tracing reported. Uncertainty remains regarding frequency of such transmission routes in broader populations.

analysis.brief_en: A 28-year-old woman in Wuhan developed flat warts on her back after three months of using shared yoga mats at public facilities, according to a dermatologist at Wuhan Third Hospital. The infection was traced to skin-type HPV, a low-risk subtype transmitted through skin contact rather than sexual transmission. Doctors noted that HPV can survive for hours on moist surfaces like yoga mats in hot, humid conditions, with infection risk heightened when skin microtrauma occurs during exercise. The case highlights the importance of personal hygiene and avoiding shared equipment in communal settings, as public awareness often focuses on HPV’s link to cervical cancer rather than skin infections.

news.title_zh: 医生谈女子用公用瑜伽垫感染HPV:夏季HPV病毒可在垫面存活数小时 - 中华网
news.source_body_en: A 28-year-old woman in Wuhan developed flat warts on her back after three months of using shared yoga mats at public facilities, according to a dermatologist at Wuhan Third Hospital. The infection was traced to skin-type HPV, a low-risk subtype transmitted through skin contact rather than sexual transmission. Doctors noted that HPV can survive for hours on moist surfaces like yoga mats in hot, humid conditions, with infection risk heightened when skin microtrauma occurs during exercise. The case highlights the importance of personal hygiene and avoiding shared equipment in communal settings, as public awareness often focuses on HPV’s link to cervical cancer rather than skin infections.
news.content_zh: 武汉市第三医院皮肤科医生表示,武汉市一名28岁女性在公共场所使用共用瑜伽垫三个月后,背部长出了扁平疣。感染被追溯到皮肤型 HPV,这是一种通过皮肤接触而非性行为传播的低风险亚型 传播。医生指出,HPV 可以在潮湿的表面(例如炎热、潮湿的条件下的瑜伽垫)上存活数小时,当运动过程中发生皮肤微损伤时,感染风险就会增加。该案例凸显了个人卫生和避免在公共环境中共用设备的重要性,因为公众意识往往关注 HPV 与 宫颈癌 的联系,而不是皮肤感染。

皮肤型HPV和宫颈癌HPV有什么区别? 2026年08月21日 00:06 看点资讯 语音播报 缩小字体 放大字体 微博 微信 分享 0 腾讯QQ QQ空间 近日,湖北武汉28岁李女士因长期使用公用瑜伽垫,后背长出大片褐色疙瘩,被确诊为皮肤型HPV感染引发的扁平疣,而此类HPV与大众恐慌的宫颈癌关联病毒并非同一类型。 一、两种HPV的核心区别 型别归属不同:HPV家族有200多种亚型,分为低危型和高危型两大类。引起扁平疣、寻常疣的是低危型皮肤HPV,主要通过皮肤接触传播,不靠性接触;与宫颈癌相关的是高危型黏膜HPV,如16、18型。 感染部位与症状差异:皮肤型HPV感染皮肤上皮,在面部、手背、后背等处长出褐色或肤色小丘疹,即各种“疣”;高危型HPV感染黏膜上皮,早期通常无症状,持续感染才可能诱发宫颈病变。 健康风险完全不同:皮肤型HPV基本不致癌,多数可被免疫系统清除;高危型HPV持续感染是宫颈癌的主要诱因,约99%的宫颈癌与高危型HPV相关。 二、公用瑜伽垫为何成为感染源 病毒存活条件:公用瑜伽垫、舞蹈垫表面缝隙容易残留汗液和皮屑,在夏季湿热环境下,HPV病毒可在垫面存活数小时。 感染机制:运动时皮肤与垫面摩擦产生肉眼难见的微小破损,后背、手臂直接接触垫面,病毒便“乘虚而入”;出汗后皮肤角质层软化、屏障减弱,感染风险更高。 抓挠加速扩散:扁平疣瘙痒时若用手抓挠,病毒会沿抓痕扩散,导致疣体呈线性排列、越抓越多。 三、科学防护与就医建议 个人防护:去健身房或瑜伽馆最稳妥的方式是自带瑜伽垫,或铺一次性隔层;必须使用公用垫时,先用消毒湿巾擦拭表面,待干后再接触皮肤。 管住手:皮肤出现不明小疙瘩切勿用手抠或抓挠,避免自体接种扩散和传染他人。 及时就医:若皮损持续增多,应前往正规医院皮肤科就诊,医生会通过液氮冷冻、激光或外用药物治疗,切勿自行网购不明药膏涂抹。 风险提示:本文内容仅供健康科普参考,不能替代专业医疗诊断。如有皮肤异常或HPV感染疑虑,请及时前往正规医院皮肤科或妇科就诊。 0条评论|0人参与网友评论 表情 登录|注册 |退出 分享到微博 发布 最热评论 刷新 最新评论 刷新 更多精彩评论>> 相关新闻 加载中 点击加载更多 头条号入驻 财经自媒体联盟更多自媒体作者 今日推荐 优秀作者 看点月榜 盘点全球具身智能30强:谁能让机器人真正工作? 皮肤型HPV和宫颈癌HPV有什么区别? 2026年08月21日 00:06 看点资讯 语音播报 缩小字体 放大字体 微博 微信 分享 0 腾讯QQ QQ空间 近日,湖北武汉28岁李女士因长期使用公用瑜伽垫,后背长出大片褐色疙瘩,被确诊为皮肤型HPV感染引发的扁平疣,而此类HPV与大众恐慌的宫颈癌关联病毒并非同一类型。 一、两种HPV的核心区别 型别归属不同:HPV家族有200多种亚型,分为低危型和高危型两大类。引起扁平疣、寻常疣的是低危型皮肤HPV,主要通过皮肤接触传播,不靠性接触;与宫颈癌相关的是高危型黏膜HPV,如16、18型。 感染部位与症状差异:皮肤型HPV感染皮肤上皮,在面部、手背、后背等处长出褐色或肤色小丘疹,即各种“疣”;高危型HPV感染黏膜上皮,早期通常无症状,持续感染才可能诱发宫颈病变。 健康风险完全不同:皮肤型HPV基本不致癌,多数可被免疫系统清除;高危型HPV持续感染是宫颈癌的主要诱因,约99%的宫颈癌与高危型HPV相关。 二、公用瑜伽垫为何成为感染源 病毒存活条件:公用瑜伽垫、舞蹈垫表面缝隙容易残留汗液和皮屑,在夏季湿热环境下,HPV病毒可在垫面存活数小时。 感染机制:运动时皮肤与垫面摩擦产生肉眼难见的微小破损,后背、手臂直接接触垫面,病毒便“乘虚而入”;出汗后皮肤角质层软化、屏障减弱,感染风险更高。 抓挠加速扩散:扁平疣瘙痒时若用手抓挠,病毒会沿抓痕扩散,导致疣体呈线性排列、越抓越多。 三、科学防护与就医建议 个人防护:去健身房或瑜伽馆最稳妥的方式是自带瑜伽垫,或铺一次性隔层;必须使用公用垫时,先用消毒湿巾擦拭表面,待干后再接触皮肤。 管住手:皮肤出现不明小疙瘩切勿用手抠或抓挠,避免自体接种扩散和传染他人。 及时就医:若皮损持续增多,应前往正规医院皮肤科就诊,医生会通过液氮冷冻、激光或外用药物治疗,切勿自行网购不明药膏涂抹。 风险提示:本文内容仅供健康科普参考,不能替代专业医疗诊断。如有皮肤异常或HPV感染疑虑,请及时前往正规医院皮肤科或妇科就诊。 0条评论|0人参与网友评论 表情 登录|注册 |退出 分享到微博 发布 最热评论 刷新 最新评论 刷新 更多精彩评论>> 相关新闻 加载中 点击加载更多 头条号入驻 财经自媒体联盟更多自媒体作者 今日推荐 优秀作者 看点月榜 盘点全球具身智能30强:谁能让机器人真正工作? analysis.brief_en: On August 21, 2026, a 28‐year‐old woman in Wuhan was diagnosed with skin‐type human papillomavirus (HPV) infection after using a public yoga mat, developing flat warts on her back. The case highlights that skin‐type HPV, which causes common warts through skin contact, is distinct from high‐risk HPV strains such as HPV‐16 and HPV‐18 that are linked to cervical cancer. While skin‐type HPV is generally non‐oncogenic and can be cleared by the immune system, high‐risk HPV persists and is responsible for nearly all cervical cancers. The article explains that the virus can survive on shared mats in warm, humid conditions and enters the body through tiny skin abrasions. Preventive measures include using personal yoga mats or disposable covers, disinfecting public mats before use, and avoiding scratching warts to prevent spread. Medical professionals advise seeking treatment from a dermatology department for warts and cautions that the information is for health education only and not a substitute for professional diagnosis.

news.content_zh: 2026年8月21日,武汉一名28岁女性在使用公共瑜伽垫后被诊断为皮肤型人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染,背部出现扁平疣。该病例强调,通过皮肤接触引起寻常疣的皮肤型 HPV 与与 宫颈癌 相关的 HPV-16 和 HPV-18 等高危 HPV 毒株不同。虽然皮肤型 HPV 通常是非致癌性的,可以被免疫系统清除,但高危 HPV 仍然存在,并且是几乎所有 宫颈癌 的罪魁祸首。文章解释说,病毒可以在温暖、潮湿的条件下在共用垫子上生存,并通过微小的皮肤擦伤进入体内。预防措施包括使用个人瑜伽垫或一次性覆盖物、使用前对公共垫子进行消毒以及避免抓伤疣以防止传播。医疗专业人士建议从皮肤科寻求 治疗 治疗疣,并警告该信息仅供健康教育之用,不能替代专业的 诊断。
